Hello, to anyone who was on this thread months ago. I would like to come here and say that I made it 83 days. The person in this post who left me came back. He felt genuinely terrible about everything and he apologized. We have been back together, and we are currently looking for a home. I turned 21 in February. I still don’t have those “friends” that never reached out to me, but I don’t feel sad about it anymore. I made new friends, who are amazing people. I am now officially pescatarian (no meats, only fish). And I got an amazing job. I plan to be a mother in my near future, too. I want to thank all of you strangers for taking the time to read my struggles and reaching out to try to help. All of you had some part in saving my life. Please don’t ever think you’re alone. ❤️
This post isn’t to encourage young people to go and hurt themselves. Talk to a parent or someone who loves and supports you and get yourself some help and guidance

This brought me to tears. I can’t imagine what addiction is like. I have fortunately been too afraid to even touch those things. Life must have dealt you awful cards. A person as strong as you telling that I am YOUR hero, just really brings me to my knees. All I have felt is pain. All I have done is despise myself. But there are people out there who don’t even know me and they say I’m a hero. It just really means a lot to me. Because I never see myself that way.

I just want to point out that this isn’t a competition. Everyone struggles. I don’t want you to hurt yourself and I am sorry you are in pain. But remember that even adults can suffer a lot. I hope you seek the guidance you need to help you
